titulo: Your song becomes a Beat Saber map
sub: Paste a link or drop an audio file. You get a map from Easy to Expert+, ready for the Quest.
convite: Pick a map from the list to watch it before you play
link: Paste a YouTube link (video or playlist)
lista_n: Playlist “{nome}”: {n} songs. Each becomes a map, one at a time, with the name and artist from the video.
solte: Or drop an audio file here
solte_dica: click to choose: mp3, ogg, wav, m4a, flac or opus
confira: check the name and artist before generating
capa_gen: no cover in the file: the generic one will be used
passo_baixando: Downloading the audio from the link…
rapido_sub: Several times faster (about 12 s instead of 78 s for a 1:40 song). It does not separate the instruments: strong notes stop following the drums and the map has no held notes and no walls.
lista_repetida: {novos} new in the queue. {pulados} already had a map and were left out; {refeitos} with a failed check will have their notes redone.
confirma_esvaziar: Remove everything that has not started yet from the queue? The song being made right now carries on.
q_novos: Send the {n} missing ones to the Quest
confirma_regerar: Redo the notes of the selected maps with the current rules and preferences? The song is not analysed again, so it is quick. The current notes are replaced.
s_gosto_sub: Applies to new maps and to the ones you redo.
sem_topo: No notes on the top row
sem_topo_sub: No note at the highest position, the one that makes you raise your arm.
sem_fila_sub: Two notes in a row never come in the same spot less than 0.3 s apart.
cruzar_sub: When the left hand hits on the right side, or the other way round. Only happens on Expert and Expert+; on the other difficulties the arms never cross.
marcar: Select {nome} to send to the Quest
q_enviado: Map is on the Quest. Restart Beat Saber (or reload songs) to see it.
q_enviados: {n} maps are on the Quest. Restart Beat Saber (or reload songs) to see them.
confirma_q_apagar: Delete this map from the Quest? It stays here on the PC.
confirma_apagar: Remove this map from the list? It goes to the saida\lixeira folder, where you can get it back.
confirma_limpar: Delete the saved analyses? Your maps stay; only the next generation of each song gets slow again.
sem_visor: The 3D viewer is not installed yet. With it you can watch the map right here on the page.
visor_dica: Space plays and pauses. Switching difficulty reloads the viewer.
v_sem: This map could not be checked
meta_sem_notas: This difficulty ended up with no notes
meta_paridade: Swings the arm can chain together
meta_visao: No note hiding the next one
meta_palmas: No swing that makes the hands collide
meta_empilhadas: No note on top of another
meta_atravessadas: No saber passing through the other hand's note
meta_folga_inicio: Time to get ready at the start
meta_nps: Notes per second within the expected range
tec_corridas: Position changes too fast for the hand
tec_ataques_p: Notes that land on a strong hit in the song
tec_ataques_c: Strong hits that became a note
v_direcoes: up {cima}, down {baixo}, left {esq}, right {dir}, diagonals {diag}, any direction {ponto}
tec_correlacao: More notes where the song is more intense (from -1 to 1)
v_janelas: {a} stretches of 4 beats, {b} of 2 and {c} of 1 taken from human maps; {r} by simple rule
regerar_sub: Only this difficulty is redone, with a different amount of notes. The others stay as they are.
s_itens_sub: Everything is downloaded into the Beatloom folder. Nothing is installed on your Windows.
d_node: Checks that the map is in the format the game accepts. 35 MB.
d_padroes: Swings taken from 1000 well-rated human maps on BeatSaver. Takes about 20 minutes; if you close it, it resumes where it stopped.
d_visor: ArcViewer, to watch the map on the page. 80 MB.
d_adb: ADB, to send maps to the headset over Wi-Fi. 8 MB.
s_quest_sub: Optional. The first time, plug the Quest into the PC with a USB cable (developer mode on), accept the prompt inside the headset and click the button. After that the cable is no longer needed.
q_sem_adb: Install “Quest connection” from the list of items first.
q_nao_responde: The Quest did not answer. It must be on and on the same Wi-Fi; if it restarted, use the cable again.
ip_ruim: That does not look like an IP. Example: 192.168.1.50
cache_tam: Saved analyses: {n}. They make the same song generate fast the second time.
motor_placa: The analysis uses the NVIDIA graphics card.
erro_tipo: Use an audio file: mp3, ogg, wav, m4a, flac or opus.
erro_link: That does not look like a link. Paste the full address, starting with https://
erro_vazio: Paste a link or choose an audio file.
erro_ytdlp: Could not download this link. Check the address or try another one.
erro_ocupado: Wait for the generation to finish.
erro_sem_quest: The Quest did not answer. Check that it is on and on the same Wi-Fi.
erro_sem_adb: The Quest connection (ADB) is not installed.
erro_sem_cabo: No Quest found on USB. Check the cable and that developer mode is on.
erro_sem_permissao: The Quest is plugged in, but you still need to accept “Allow USB debugging” inside the headset.
erro_nao_achou: No Quest answered on the network. It must be on, awake and on the same Wi-Fi; if it restarted, the wireless connection turns off and the USB cable is needed again.
erro_sem_rede: This computer is not on any network.
erro_sem_wifi: The Quest is not connected to any Wi-Fi.
